additional_info.subject: NOTE FROM L3
additional_info.body:
RC is asking for DC2 QA13-14 error not Meter_BC5_AC_Charging error.
Check the timeframe he provided, this is typical replace contactor.
If there was a parallel session, e.g, it was charging DC2 and someone went to charge DC1 and we get CMD=ON and FBK=OFF right after, then it's replace it.
If the error is just there, then you need to check if the Voltage Transducer is reading correctly, after ~15V in the output of QA13-14 the error is triggered as FBK=ON (when in idle or one charging session only), in this case, the easiest is to check the XDsomething loose connector and try swapping TF1 with TF2, if the error persists in the same, then it's possible that the transducer needs replacement, if it's in the working one then it's something on that circuit.

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0469614
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-IL SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:

Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P4 170000447

q1Mu9c

Medium
Handover reason:
Following the report and after our checks, we confirmed that the problem is related to QA 13 -14. After reviewing the logs, as shown in the screenshot, QA 13-14 do not provide feedback when they receive the command. Because of this, we need to proceed with a replacement.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-IL SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,

Younes Baroudi
